tagline: Apache Pinot is an open-source distributed OLAP datastore for user-facing and agent-facing real-time analytics, delivering sub-second queries on fresh data at very high concurrency.
heroDescription: Apache Pinot™ is a real-time distributed OLAP datastore that delivers sub-second queries over streaming and batch data. Purpose-built for user-facing analytics, it handles hundreds of thousands of queries per second with millisecond latency at petabyte scale.
shortDescription: Real-time distributed OLAP datastore for user-facing analytics
